data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Is climate change a real threat? ASSISTANT:

Yes, climate change is a real threat. According to the United Nations Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, climate change is already having a significant impact on the global environment and has caused an increase in global average temperatures, sea level rise, extreme weather events, and an increase in ocean acidity. These changes have a direct and negative impact on human health and well-being, as well as on the environment.
